verdict.rationale: RudderStack's own docs cover each part of the story. Live Events shows source and destination events in near real-time. The Health Dashboard gives pipeline monitoring and key metrics. Alerts notify on critical data issues, and the MCP server investigates destination delivery errors with root cause analysis. All of this comes from one-line docs-index summaries rather than in-depth feature documentation. missing for 10: detailed docs on per-destination delivery metrics and failure breakdowns, specifics of alert configuration (triggers and channels), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the debugger and live-event views.
